 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 19-10-2023 Heard Ms. Shashi Priya Pathak, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks permission to make the complainant as Opposite Party No. 2.
3. The permission is accorded.
4. The same must be done in course of day.

5. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 379 of 2021, in which cognizance has been taken for the offences punishable under Sections 149, 323, 384, 386, 419, 420,
506, 504 307, 364, and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.

6. Considering the nature of allegation that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.65268 of 2023(2)
dt.19-10-2023 petitioner along with others duped the informant and his son on the pretext of providing service in Railway, let notice be issued to the newly added Opposite Party under both processes, i.e. ordinary as well as registered cover post with A/D, for which necessary requisites Fantus Singh @ Amit Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70955618/
1 must be filed within a period of three weeks from today.
7. Re-notify this case after receipt of service report or on appearance of the Opposite Party No. 2 or on 30.11.2023, whichever is earlier.
8.
